judgments.reason: The dataset's DOI is this arXiv report (Oikonomou et al. 2016), with the same authors. It introduces the MAMEM SSVEP dataset and evaluates algorithms on it, so it is the dataset's source paper.
judgments.paper_title: Comparative evaluation of state-of-the-art algorithms for SSVEP-based BCIs

judgments.reason: Figshare record of MAMEM EEG SSVEP Dataset I (256 channels, 11 subjects, 5 frequencies) is a deposit of the same data as this dataset, with matching subjects, frequencies, and sampling rate.
judgments.paper_title: MAMEM EEG SSVEP Dataset I (256 channels, 11 subjects, 5 frequencies)

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used in dataset conversion, not a paper describing the MAMEM1 SSVEP data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification used to format the dataset, not a paper describing the MAMEM1 SSVEP recordings.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
